Yes — as of today (4 September 2026) the Irish standard VAT rate is 23%, and electronically‑supplied/digital services supplied to Irish consumers are taxed at that standard rate. ([revenue.ie](https://www.revenue.ie/en/vat/vat-rates/search-vat-rates/current-VAT-rates.aspx?utm_source=openai))
